description: Get recent rainfall observations in mm for an EA rainfall gauge to inspect measured rainfall. Use a station_id from rainfall_stations; latest_n defaults to one reading per measure. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

latest_n.description: Number of latest readings per measure (default 1, maximum 100).

station_id.description: Station identifier returned by the corresponding provider's station discovery tool.

name: rainfall_latest
